title: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.8, 4.1.x before 4.1.10, and 4.2.x before…
description: A vulnerability exists in web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library versions before 3.4.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.8, 4.1.x before 4.1.10, and 4.2.x before 4.2.4, as well as jwt-encryption-algorithm-ecdh-es through 3.2.10. The ConcatKDF::generate() function uses a single SHA-256 round to derive keys for ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS direct key agreement, limiting derived key length to 32 bytes. This flaw allows decryption of JWE tokens using A256CBC-HS512 under an all-zero AES key, and reduces the strength of A192CBC-HS384 content keys to 64 bits.
